title: 80s horror nobody renewed
blurb: Ten from the video-store decade that ended up on the Archive. Slashers, body horror, a splatter comedy shot on weekends. Watch Scanners first and see where the head goes.

films.note: Cronenberg. Telepaths, corporate conspiracy, and the most famous exploding head in film.
A mining town, a Valentine's dance, a killer in a gas mask. The uncut version.
Joe Dante's werewolves, with Rob Bottin's transformation done live on set.
Joe Spinell stalks New York. Tom Savini did the effects and plays a victim.
Say his name above a whisper and Madman Marz comes. A summer-camp slasher done straight.
Three Stephen King stories, a cat, and Drew Barrymore versus a troll in the wall.
Susan Tyrrell as the aunt from hell. Stranger than any slasher of its year.
Stephen King's short story, Nebraska, and a town run by children.
Peter Jackson's first film, made on weekends over four years with his friends. Aliens want humans for fast food.
Disney's attempt at a horror film, with Bette Davis. Scarier than it had any right to be.
